items.markdown:
![Kata Noi Beach: The Most Luxurious Beach in Phuket](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07271508-1672-0139-0000-6b3780ec71a4:4)
Kata Noi Beach is `a peaceful, scenic cove featuring fine white sand, crystal-clear water, and a relaxed atmosphere just south of Kata Beach` . It is well-known for great swimming in the high season and surfing during the monsoon months.[](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-noi-beach-phuket/) [[1]](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-noi-beach-phuket/)[[2]](https://thailandbeaches.org/kata-noi-beach-phuket/)[[3]](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/kata-noi-beach)[[4]](https://www.bestpricetravel.com/travel-guide/kata-noi-beach.html)

Key Features

- **Location:** Situated on the southwest coast of Phuket, Thailand, tucked at the end of a dead-end road roughly 20 km from Phuket Town.
- **Size:** Measures about 700 meters long, making it much smaller and quieter than the neighboring main Kata Beach.
- **Water Conditions:** Calm, clear turquoise waters from December to April ideal for families and swimming, while May to October brings larger waves that attract surfers.
- **Snorkeling:** Rocky headlands at the north and south ends host colorful tropical fish and coral.[](https://thailandbeaches.org/kata-noi-beach-phuket/) [[1]](https://www.bestpricetravel.com/travel-guide/kata-noi-beach.html)

Accommodations and Dining

- **Luxury Resorts:** Dominated by high-end properties like Katathani Phuket Beach Resort, The Shore at Katathani , and Mom Tri's Villa Royale.[](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-noi-beach-phuket/) 
- **Food & Drink:** Limited casual street food directly on the sand, but a selection of local restaurants line Kata Noi Road, alongside upscale hillside dining options nearby.[](https://www.phuket101.net/kata-noi-beach-phuket/)
